from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single court document record extracted for evaluation."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title or label of the judgment document provided in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or dispute category recorded in the document")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The general legal nature of the case, e.g. 'Civil', 'Criminal', 'Administrative'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CourtDocument]
